messages:
alex: ran a 2k-sample pass on model-seed-13b int6 this morning, saw a weird latency tail on long prompts (~2.1k tokens)
kim: ugh, numbers?
sophie: do you mean p95/p99 bump or overall mean up?
alex: mean is fine, p95 jumped from 180ms to 420ms for 2k+ sequences on dedicated nodes. token-cost roughly +12% vs baseline 13b-int8 because of longer kernel paths.
raj: did you reproduce on a cold vs warm kv cache?
alex: warm cache still shows tail, cold worse. suspect attention kernel fallback when sequence > 1024 triggers different execution path.
kim: any quality diffs? perf tradeoff might be ok if outputs match.
alex: small fidelity check: exact-match on synthetic QA down 0.8% and rouge-L -0.6 vs int8 baseline (small reg). but hallucination probes up a notch on reasoning slices.
sophie: so cost +12%, latency tail, tiny quality regression. product impact depending on slice. recommend hold for GTN until we test hybrid routing.
raj: Agreed. propose routing rule: short (<1024) -> 13b-int6, long -> fallback 13b-int8 with conservative beam/penalty to reduce hallucination. also try kv-prefetch batching.
kim: can you paste a quick flag example we can push to staging?
alex: sure:

```json
{
  "routing": [
    {"max_seq": 1024, "model": "seed-13b-int6"},
    {"default": "seed-13b-int8"}
  ],
  "prefetch_kv": true,
  "batch_window_ms": 12
}
```

sophie: add a quality gate: run prompt-set A (reasoning) on candidate traffic and fail if hallucination rate > 1.5x baseline.
raj: also toggle quant-sim (simulate int6 on int8 runtime) to debug kernel fallback effect before full int6 rollout.
eng-bot: canary deploy queued: routing-config v3 -> staging at 4887654350 (user: alex) :rocket:
kim: plan sounds good. next steps: alex -> run quant-sim slices + prefetch experiment; sophie -> craft gating prompts; raj -> infra watch p99 latency and KV metrics. check back EOD. :thumbsup:
